values.meaning: Stacks required to consume and deal bonus damage
values.binNote: No data value in the bin encodes the stack cap; it is implicit in the design (three named stack fields / on-hit consumption logic not exposed as a DataValue) and only appears in the wiki description.

mechanics.claim: Basic attacks on-hit and Condemn apply a stack of Silver Bolts; the third stack consumes all three to deal the bonus true damage.
mechanics.quote: '''Vayne's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Condemn|Vayne}}'' apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Silver Bolts'' for {{fd|3.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications, expiring upon attacking a new enemy, and stacking up to 3 times.

mechanics.claim: Stacks expire upon attacking a new enemy, but are irrelevant in a single-target dummy fight since there is no target switching.
mechanics.quote: expiring upon attacking a new enemy

mechanics.claim: Silver Bolts deals reduced/modified true damage against monsters instead of the max-health-based damage; not applicable against a champion-flagged dummy.
Silver Bolts has no cooldown of its own; it is a passive proc from basic attacks and Condemn, not a separately cast/cooldown-gated ability.
mechanics.quote: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Vayne's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Condemn|Vayne}}'' apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Silver Bolts''
